Priya: quick heads-up — cadet pilot seat cap at 25; need to swap 5 seats from internal waitlist to Springfield trial by EOD. Also want to gather 2-week feedback — who can run a short enablement session? :wave:

Jon: I can free up 3 seats (we have 4 dev seats slated). Maya, can you take 2? @Maya

Maya: I can cover 2 enablement slots Tue/Wed 11am PT. Need the onboarding checklist + sample prompts.

Priya: sending checklist in a sec. Also pinging @Ben for runtime quotas — noticed spikes during demo that blocked some customers.

Ben: saw the spikes — looks like batching config for cadet model is throttling. Patch suggestion: increase `max_concurrent_requests` to 40 in the dedicated pool. snippet:
```yaml
pool:
  max_concurrent_requests: 40
  batch_window_ms: 15
```
I'll open a PR.

Alyssa: I'll prep the 2-question pulse survey. Link: https://forms.redwood/pilot-cadet-2wk (short). Can we include a quick rating + "what's broken"? :memo:

Priya: perfect. Also add a checkbox about UI latency and hallucination incidents.

Jon: FYI, Springfield needs SSO onboarding — eng needs SAML cert by Mon. I'll coordinate with R&D.

Maya: can someone drop the sample prompts? I want to tailor the enablement.

Priya: attaching prompts below ⬇️
```text
- Use case A: summarize call notes
- Use case B: generate follow-up emails
- Safety check: flag PII
```

deploy-bot: Feature flag `cadet-pilot` enabled in us-west-2 at 2024-08-15T16:20:03Z

Ben: PR opened: #4823 — rolling patch to batching. Will monitor metrics. @Jon can you confirm no SSO traffic will cause CPU surge?

Jon: confirmed. We'll stagger onboarding invites (10/day) to smooth traffic.

Priya: Action items:
- Ben: monitor + merge patch (target today)
- Alyssa: survey live by EOD
- Maya: enablement slides + prompts (shared drive)
- Jon: SSO cert + invite cadence
I'll update the pilot doc after items done. Thanks everyone :rocket:

Maya: ack

Alyssa: survey is live, dropping results in #customer-success when we have 10 responses.
